summary: Defines three Elliptic Curve Cryptography groups based on modular arithmetic modulo a prime, for use in IKE and IKEv2. They align the protocols with NIST standards and can be more efficient than earlier ECC groups. It is informational and replaced RFC 4753.

eli5.summary: Secret-sharing in IPsec uses special math shapes. This adds three more efficient shapes that match what other security systems already use.
